title: Do Large Language Models Favor Recent Content? A Study on Recency Bias in LLM-Based Reranking
abstract: arXiv:2509.11353v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in information systems, including being used as second-stage rerankers in information retrieval pipelines, yet their susceptibility to recency bias has received little attention. We investigate whether LLMs implicitly favour newer documents by prepending artificial publication dates to passages in the TREC Deep Learning passage retrieval collections in 2021 (DL21) and 2022 (DL22). Across seven models, GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4o, GPT-4, LLaMA-3 8B/70B, and Qwen-2.5 7B/72B, "fresh" passages are consistently promoted, shifting the Top-10's mean publication year forward by up to 4.78 years and moving individual items by as many as 95 ranks in our listwise reranking experiments. Although larger models attenuate the effect, none eliminate it. We also observe that the preference of LLMs between two passages with an identical relevance level can be reversed by up to 25% on average after date

translated_title: 大语言模型是否偏好近期内容？基于LLM重排序中的新近性偏差研究
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被部署在信息系统中，包括在信息检索流程中充当第二阶段的重排序器，但它们对新近性偏差的易感性却很少受到关注。我们通过在TREC深度学习段落检索数据集2021年（DL21）和2022年（DL22）的段落前人工添加发布日期，来研究LLM是否隐式地偏好较新的文档。在七个模型——GPT-3.5-turbo、GPT-4o、GPT-4、LLaMA-3 8B/70B和Qwen-2.5 7B/72B——的实验中，“新鲜”的段落始终被提升，使Top-10结果的平均发布年份最多向前推移了4.78年，在我们的列表式（listwise）重排序实验中，个别条目最多移动了95个排名位次。虽然更大的模型能减弱这种效应，但没有任何模型能完全消除它。我们还观察到，对于两个相关性水平相同的段落，在添加日期信息后，LLM对它们的偏好平均会被逆转高达25%。
tldr: 该研究揭示了基于大语言模型的重排序器存在系统性的新近性偏差——模型会偏好发布日期较新的文档，导致Top-10结果平均年份前移最多4.78年、个别条目排名变动达95位，且即使是更大的模型也只能减弱而无法消除这种偏差。
en_tdlr: This study reveals a systematic recency bias in LLM-based rerankers, where models favor newer documents—shifting the Top-10's mean publication year forward by up to 4.78 years and individual items by as many as 95 ranks—and larger models only attenuate but never eliminate this bias.
